worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.summary: Call a pillar of weird light down onto the target: it bends toward the target as it falls, deals special damage on impact and harshly strips 2 stages of Sp. Def, splashing everyone inside the ground ring; the target keeps a weird afterglow. A target that runs far enough during the fall dodges it. Dispersed form crashes a group with a lighter hit; focused form is a thin pillar that hits one much harder.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.use.0: Harshly strip 2 stages of Sp. Def off one target for a special attacker
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.use.1: Call a light down onto a marked target from range
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.use.2: Use dispersed form to crash the landing point and everything around it
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.descriptio: The light pillar deals %1$s special damage on impact and harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).

The pillar is called down from above the target and lands %1$s later; if the target moves %2$s blocks away during the fall, the pillar lands where it was and no longer follows, and the target is struck only if it stays within the burst radius of the landing point.
On impact every other foe within %1$s blocks of the point takes %2$s splash damage; only the target struck by the pillar loses Sp. Def.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.disperse.o: Dispersed form: impact %1$s, burst radius %2$s blocks, splash %3$s — crashing the group too.
Focused form: impact %1$s, burst radius %2$s blocks — one thin pillar, one target.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar rises to %2$s power and the burst to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.preference: On: burst radius x1.5, splash x1.3 and cast range x0.95, but pillar impact x0.85, +2 ticks wind-up and +5 ticks cooldown - for crashing a group. Off (focused): one thin pillar with a heavier single hit.
Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
On: when other enemies stand near the target it prioritizes the light, crashing the landing point and the group. Off: it sorts like an ordinary attack.
